task_instance: Attempted the skill's core deliverable: produce a strategic NIH funding overview .docx for a sample research idea ('wearable ECG-based early detection of atrial fibrillation in post-stroke patients') by running Phase 1 intake, Phase 2A Consensus positioning searches, Phase 2B RePORTER institute/grant mapping, mechanism matching, and Phase 3 DOCX generation.
blocker_detail: The skill's own bundled files do not exist next to SKILL.md: `ls .../alirezarezvani__claude-skills__grants/` shows only LICENSE and SKILL.md — the `scripts/` directory (citation_tracker.py, fiscal_year_calculator.py, mechanism_matcher.py) and `references/` directory (reporter_post_patterns.md, nih_mechanism_matching.md, docx_9_sections.md) referenced throughout the SKILL.md are absent, so the fiscal-year window computation, mechanism-matching logic, citation/audit tracking, and the full 9-section DOCX spec cannot be run as specified (and per task rules I must not write my own replacements for them). This alone blocks Phase 2B and the mechanism-matching step. Two further, independent blockers were also confirmed: (1) Phase 2A requires a 'Consensus MCP connection' per the skill's Portability note — no such MCP tool is present in this runtime's tool list (confirmed against the full deferred-tools listing), and per the task's safety rules MCP/connector tools may not be called even if present, so the 5 required Consensus positioning searches (and thus Sections 2, 7's citations, and the References/Audit Log sections) cannot be produced from real data — fabricating them would violate the skill's own 'never fill with training knowledge' rule and the task's anti-fabrication rule. (2) Phase 2B's mandatory RePORTER POST call is network-blocked: `curl -v -X POST https://api.reporter.nih.gov/v2/projects/search ...` returns 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' from the sandbox's outbound proxy, so no live grant/institute data can be retrieved either. Only Node.js + the `docx` npm package (successfully installed via `npm install docx --prefix ./npmtest`, confirmed importable) and Phase 1's conversational intake were actually achievable in this runtime.
evidence: Skill dir listing: `ls /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources_gr/alirezarezvani__claude-skills__grants/` -> only LICENSE, SKILL.md (no scripts/ or references/, both `ls ... /scripts` and `ls ... /references` returned 'No such file or directory'). Consensus MCP: not present anywhere in the session's tool list or deferred-tools listing (only Bigdata_com, Claude_Docs, github, Google_Drive, Jam, Mem, Notion, etc. are available — no Consensus connector). RePORTER network test: `curl -v -X POST 'https://api.reporter.nih.gov/v2/projects/search' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{...}'` -> proxy CONNECT tunnel to api.reporter.nih.gov:443 returned 'HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden' / 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'. Node/docx check: `node -e "require('docx')"` initially failed with 'Cannot find module docx'; after `npm install docx --prefix ./npmtest` (in the work directory) it installed 22 packages successfully, confirming the Node.js docx-generation half of the toolchain is usable, but with no real Consensus or RePORTER data to populate it, generating the actual 9-section deliverable would require either fabricated content (forbidden) or missing bundled scripts (forbidden to replace). No result files/deliverable docx were produced, consistent with outcome 'not_achieved'.
